stem:
A fair spinner is divided into sections of equal size. Each section contains the picture of a diamond, a star, or a triangle.

Which statement about the result of spinning the arrow is true?

options.label: A
options.text: It is more likely to land on a diamond than on a star.

options.label: B
options.text: It is equally likely to land on a triangle, a star, or a diamond.

options.label: C
options.text: It is 4 times as likely to land on a diamond as it is to land on a star.

options.label: D
options.text: It is less likely to land on a diamond than on a star.

visual_elements: spinner with 8 sections: 3 diamonds, 3 stars, 1 triangle, 1 triangle
